title: Chess Game Export
description: Format for a game exported from the app (finished or in progress). JSON has no comment syntax, so every field is documented here instead via "description" — keep this file next to the exporter code as the source of truth for the format.

exportDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the export was generated, e.g. "2026-09-13T14:32:00Z".

version.description: Export format version, e.g. "1.0". Bump this whenever the shape of this file changes, so old exports can still be read.

mode.description: How the game was played: local wifi, bluetooth, versus the built-in AI, or via the online room/quick-match server.

players.description: The two players, keyed by the color they played.

result.description: Outcome of the game. Use null if the export happens mid-game (e.g. a manual save).

startingFen.description: FEN of the position the game started from. Use the standard starting FEN for a normal game, or a custom FEN if the game began from a puzzle/level position.

moves.description: Every move played, in order, starting from startingFen.

type.description: Whether this side was played by a person or the AI.

piece.description: The piece that moved, using its type letter (P=pawn, N=knight, B=bishop, R=rook, Q=queen, K=king) — not the piece it became after promotion.

promotion.description: Set only when a pawn promotes; the piece it promoted to.

isCastle.description: "K" for kingside castling, "Q" for queenside, null otherwise.

captured.description: The piece type captured by this move, or null if it wasn't a capture.

fen.description: Optional: the resulting FEN right after this move. Lets a viewer jump to any point in the game without replaying every move from the start.
